title: 1970 Strange Situation: Why Quiet Babies Hid Racing Hearts
topic: Mary Ainsworth 1970 Strange Situation & Spangler-Grossmann 1993 Cardiac-Cortisol Dissociation: Why Avoidant Toddlers Hid Racing Hearts Behind Silence
act5_climax_episode: In 1993, Gottfried Spangler and Klaus Grossmann recorded continuous ECG heart rate and 15/30-minute salivary cortisol in 41 twelve-month-old infants during the Strange Situation, discovering that quiet avoidant infants experienced tachycardia and cortisol surges matching or exceeding crying infants.
